## Course Goals
.pull-left[

### Develop skills in animal movement analysis

Roughly: 

- manipulation
- visualization & summarization
- models of movement
- behavioral structure / segmentation
- home ranges
- resource & step-selection
- **special topics of interest to students**

Everything in .blue.Large[**R**]

]
